Title: Azure SQL—Public preview updates for mid-April 2023

Body.Content:
In mid-April 2023, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL:  

Enable database-level transparent data encryption (TDE) with customer-managed keys for Azure SQL Database 

Enable cross-tenant transparent data encryption (TDE) with customer-managed keys for Azure SQL Database
